title: Waiting Midnights by Kind of Absence for Assisted Living Absence Credits
content:
**Wellness Department and Business Office decision table — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.**

The waiting midnights of the absence-relief credit depend on the kind of absence and its medical follow-up:

- a **hospital** absence followed by a post-hospital reassessment completed no later than 3 calendar days after the return date waits **7 midnights**;
- a **rehabilitation-facility** absence, or a hospital absence **without** such a timely post-hospital reassessment, waits **10 midnights**.

Any other kind of absence, such as a family visit, is not governed by this table.

**Timely post-hospital reassessment.** The reassessment considered is the most recent post-hospital reassessment recorded on the residency. It is timely when it was completed on the absence return date or on one of the 3 calendar days after it: the return date is day 0, a reassessment on day 3 is timely, and one on day 4 is not. A post-hospital reassessment dated before the return date does not follow the absence, and a hospital absence with no post-hospital reassessment on record has none.

| Absence reason recorded | Most recent post-hospital reassessment | Waiting midnights |
|---|---|---|
| Hospital | Day 0 to day 3 after the return date | 7 |
| Hospital | Day 4 or later after the return date | 10 |
| Hospital | None on record, or dated before the return date | 10 |
| Rehabilitation facility | Any, or none | 10 |
| Family visit | — | Not governed by this table |

### Cases (hypothetical dates)

- Hospital absence ending 10 June, post-hospital reassessment on 13 June: day 3, timely — 7 waiting midnights.
- Same absence, reassessment on 14 June: day 4, not timely — 10 waiting midnights.
- Rehabilitation-facility stay ending 2 September, reassessment on 3 September: the absence is not a hospital absence — 10 waiting midnights.
